steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: No, no. That's not it...
In the garden full of blooming flowers, the perfumer pushes away the various ingredients in front of her, an unusual look of irritation appearing on her usually indifferent face.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: What a strange smell... Isn't this the most fascinating perfume corner on the island? Did something happen to the perfume master?
Ever since the island sank to the bottom of the sea, L.L.'s movements have become noticeably livelier. She bounces in small steps toward Cassia's garden.

Cassia is sitting in the flower garden tailored for her, surrounded by overturned perfume bottles. Incredibly fragrant when smelled on their own, the perfumes now give off an indescribably decadent scent all mixed together.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: What's going on? How come the perfumes have all been knocked over...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Not nearly good enough. I need them to be more vibrant, more imperishable!

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: The scents have all changed here at the bottom of the sea. Some have become purer and madder, while others have grown sweeter, more decayed...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: But that scent I've been searching for is nowhere to be found. Oh, dear me. Is that death I see drawing near...
Cassia's hand trembles slightly. Seeing this, L.L. immediately holds it in her palm, comforting her.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: No, that's not real. This place... will only fulfill all your desires. There won't be any death.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: If you wish for it sincerly, that imperishable scent you pursue will surely come to you.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Forget those things that trouble you. Just remember what makes you happy!
Cassia looks at the girl in front of her, and for some reason, part of the anxiety looming over her heart seems to have faded.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: ...Are you the master of this place? The one who promises everyone pleasure and desire?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: But you don't carry any scents. No enchanting aroma of beauty or decadent stench of one consumed in desire...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: You are insipid, just like water... That's curious. A "perfume ingredient" like you really is a first for me... Perhaps your body is worth studying after all...
Cassia strokes a strand of L.L.'s hair absentmindedly, leaning in to sniff its scent, muttering to herself as if not hearing L.L.'s question at all.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: My body? Oh right, I hear that your perfume ingredients are hard to come by. They are both unique and frightening...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Are you interested? Hehe, looks like you're bolder and have better taste than most others...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Each part of the human body exudes a distinct smell... Here it is mild but dissipates easily, and here it is more vibrant...
The perfumer's hand brushes through L.L.'s long hair, caresses her cheek, and slides down her body. The movement is so gentle that it's almost tender, yet so assertive that it brooks no resistance.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: And here is the toughest part to extract for use, but it produces the most enduring scents which serve as the best materials for the Immortal Fragrance.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Immortal Fragrance? Is that what you desire?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: If I provide you with the ingredients to make this perfume, you'll be glad, right?

Cassia's gaze laps over L.L.'s shoulder fervently. She looks as if she's going to agree immediately and then take apart the girl in front of her to turn her into an ingredient. However, her answer comes as a surprise.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Yes. But what I want is beyond your reach. Even if you give yourself up for my formula, it is impossible to concoct the Immortal Fragrance down here...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: The salty sea water has compromised the scents of usable parts, so the amounts have to be recalculated...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: And the worst part is: the beauty, the most crucial ingredient is also gone...

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: The most crucial ingredient is gone?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Yes, yes, gone. I tracked down that scent on the island, but have been unable to find it after sinking beneath the sea.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I see...

L.L. closes her eyes, immediately picturing a gray-clad demon who has been causing trouble on the island. That person's destructive actions have caused her incalculable losses. But that's fine, she and Elysiland are strong enough.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I understand. Miss Cassia, you can rest assured. This is Elysiland, where no wish goes unfulfilled, no desire unsatisfied!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: I will make sure to bring him to you! As for you, you just have fun making perfumes here and wait for my good news!
steps.female_content: I will make sure to bring her to you! As for you, you just have fun making perfumes here and wait for my good news!

steps.content: She waves her hand, summoning a crowd of colorful marine creatures, which decorate the flowers and emit various sweet scents.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Keep filling the void of your desires and pushing beyond the limits of your cravings! Turn all the creatures you fancy into perfumes!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: By then, he will surely come to you and be at your disposal! Consider this a promise from Elysiland's owner!
steps.female_content: By then, she will surely come to you and be at your disposal! Consider this a promise from Elysiland's owner!

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: What you are saying is but an empty promise to me. I've been on this island for quite some time now, but the necessary ingredients are nowhere to be seen, let alone the Immortal Fragrance...
Cassia tightens her grip, breaking off a few strands of L.L.'s hair. She puts the blue strands into the ingredient box, then looks up at L.L.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Can you really deliver on your promise?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Can I deliver? Ever since you came to Elysiland, I've delivered on countless promises and granted more wishes for you than I can count, haven't I?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Everyone! Everyone who comes here has their wishes granted! Any wish that seems hopeless and impossible in reality! And of course yours too, why not?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: And what's the harm in doing as I say, Miss Cassia?

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: When your most fervent wish can't be gratified, lesser ones need be prioritized to ease your anxiety and quench your yearnings... That's how things are meant to be, right?

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: Mmm, meant to be...
The perfumer looks down at the abundant ingredients before her. The thick crimson liquid, the delicate milky white chunks, and the smooth colorful threads, all at her disposal.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: True. I've always comforted myself with the possession of these fragrances, until I can finally create the Immortal Fragrance...

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: That's my desire too, one that deserves to be fulfilled...

She murmurs, completely convinced by L.L. Following her advice, the perfumer immerses herself in her perfume-making again, indulging in a new wave of satisfaction in the midst of the marine creatures.

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Yes, that's right... Indulge yourself, enjoy yourself!

steps.speaker: L.L.
steps.content: Even if the pleasure is fleeting and bound to fade, we can create the illusion of eternity with abundance and continuity!
The young island owner nods in contentment and transforms into foam in the seawater.
Shortly after she disappears, a figure in a gray trench coat steps over the illusory flowers and branches, arriving before Cassia.
Cassia's eyes light up in that moment, as if a long-suppressed desire deep within her soul is instantly kindled.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: This scent... a mere whiff is enough to calm you down.

steps.speaker: Cassia
steps.content: It's, you. You're here, at long last.
Before the gray figure speaks, the perfumer absorbed in her perfume-making looks up immediately. The immense joy dispels the mist of desire, making her eyes glow with a different kind of clarity.
...A fall induced by irresistible desire can only be interrupted by an even stronger desire... I understand it now.
The gray figure smiles wryly and waves at Cassia.
I've never been so grateful for your obsession with me as an "ingredient", Cassia.
Come on, it's time to go back.
